assessments.reasoning: agpl_terms [28959,29400) identifies both permitted acts, requires a single combined work, names GPL version 3, and assigns continuing terms to each part. Its permission is distinct from the preceding source-inclusion sentence.

challenge.method: Tested the permission against AGPLv3 §5's whole-work licensing condition, its aggregate provision, independent co-deployment, and substitution of a GPLv2-only grant.
challenge.results: Section 13 expressly overrides conflicting AGPL provisions for this route and specifies the terms retained by each part. Independent programs running on one host do not thereby form one work. A §5 aggregate consists of separate independent works on a medium, subject to its stated conditions, and inclusion does not extend AGPL terms to the other parts. A GPLv2-only grant supplies no GPLv3 authorization for this route.

limitations: The publisher text supplies the rule. Whether components form one work and whether the requisite grants exist depend on facts about those components.
reasoning: AGPLv3 §13 paragraph two permits linking or combining an AGPLv3-covered work with a work licensed under GPLv3 to form one work and permits conveying the result. AGPLv3 continues on its covered part and GPLv3 continues on the work incorporated under this permission.
